invariants.rationale: instantTime typically identifies the commit or operation and should not be null for an upsert.
records must be provided for the upsert operation to process meaningful work.
context is required for the execution environment of upsert and should not be null.
If there are records to process, there must be a valid instantTime string (not empty).
No useful relationship can be established between records and other parameters beyond non-nullity and in some APIs empty upserts may be allowed, so this is a placeholder invariant.
